info.title: Scouting Platform API (Super Admin & Multi-Tenant Clubs)
info.description:
Complete API specification for the Scouting multi-tenant platform.

## Hosts

| Host | Serves |
|---|---|
| `sportego.org` | Super Admin API |
| `admin.sportego.org`, `api.sportego.org`, `www.sportego.org` | Super Admin API (reserved labels) |
| `<club>.sportego.org` | Tenant API of that club (e.g. `ahly.sportego.org`) |

The tenant is the **first label before the dot**: `ahly.sportego.org` -> club `ahly` -> MongoDB database `ahly`.
Every club owns a separate database, and a token issued for one club is rejected by another.

Super Admin routes (`/api/auth`, `/api/clubs`, ...) are reachable from the apex and from the reserved hosts only;
a request from a tenant host such as `ahly.sportego.org/api/clubs` returns **403**.

`/api/tenant/*` also accepts the `x-subdomain` header or the `?subdomain=` query parameter,
which is what the local development server and mobile clients use.

servers.description: Local Development Server (use 'x-subdomain' header or ?subdomain= for tenant routes)

subdomain.description: Club subdomain identifier (also the database name)

SuperAdminAuth.description: Super Admin JWT token returned from POST /api/auth/login

TenantAuth.description: Tenant JWT token returned from POST /api/tenant/auth/login

TenantSubdomain.name: x-subdomain
TenantSubdomain.description: Club subdomain (e.g. 'ahly'). Optional in production: the tenant is taken from the host (`ahly.sportego.org`). Required on localhost or when calling the API from the apex domain.

BadRequest.description: Validation error or invalid request body

Forbidden.description: The token is valid but the account/role cannot perform this action, the club is disabled, or the subscription is expired (scouting workspace only).

error.message: Your subscription has expired. Please renew to continue.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state (duplicate, or a protected document).

error.message: This package is already in your cart.

get.description: Checks server status, uptime, and database connectivity

post.description: Authenticates super admin and returns Bearer JWT token

get.description: Returns platform wide stats, active clubs, subscription statuses, orders, and revenue chart

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Number of months for revenue breakdown (1-24)

get.description: Returns lightweight active games array for dropdowns

delete.description: Deletes the game and its catalog actions/packages. Fails with 409 if clubs are subscribed unless `?force=true`.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Cascade delete clubs that use this game's packages

post.description: Registers a new club, provisions its isolated database and creates the first club admin in the same call. `admin_name`, `admin_email` and `admin_password` are required.

patch.description: Same handler as `PUT /api/clubs/{id}`. The `subdomain` is immutable once the club database exists.

get.description: Inspects the isolated MongoDB database of this club and counts rows in teams, players, matches, etc.

post.summary: Forgot Club Password (Reset from Super Admin)
post.description: Resets the club admin password without touching DB directly. Generates strong random password if none is provided and returns it once.
Accepts `multipart/form-data` with an `icon` image file, or JSON where `icon` is a URL.

requestBody.description: Provide `icon` as a URL or as an uploaded file.

icon.description: Icon URL, or upload the image in the `icon` field

post.description: Creates a pending order on behalf of a club. `payment_proof` can be sent as a URL or as an uploaded file (`multipart/form-data`). New orders stay `pending` until a super admin approves them.

put.description: Accepts `multipart/form-data` when a new `payment_proof` file is attached.

requestBody.description: At least one field is required.

example.notes: Called the club to confirm the transfer

post.description: Super admin marks the pending order as paid. This atomically extends the club's end_date by the package cycle length.

example.reason: Payment receipt unreadable or transfer not received

example.rejection_reason: Payment receipt unreadable or transfer not received

get.description: Returns structured invoice data. Pass `?format=html` to render printable HTML.
Directly returns clean, print-ready HTML page with print button

post.description: Authenticates club admin, coach, or viewer against this club's isolated database.

parameters.name: x-subdomain
parameters.description: Club subdomain. Optional when the request already targets `ahly.sportego.org`.

patch.description: Same handler as `PUT /api/tenant/auth/change-password`. Changing the password revokes every previously issued tenant token (`password_version`).

get.description: Returns everything the tenant dashboard needs on initial load: club profile, days left in subscription, database name, settings, and entity counts.

get.summary: Browse Available Packages to Buy / Renew
get.description: Returns all active subscription packages with calculated savings, durations, and whether the package is the club's current active plan.
Returns active payment methods where clubs can transfer subscription fees (e.g. InstaPay address, Vodafone Cash, Bank Account).
Returns all past and current package orders made by this club, with approval status and pricing snapshots.

post.description: Creates a pending order for this club in one step (it does not touch the cart, and it does not clear existing cart lines). `payment_reference` is not accepted from the tenant: only `payment_method_id` + a payment proof (file or URL). The response returns the order populated with its `package` (including all `cycles`) and the exact `cycle` that was bought.

example.message: Package purchased successfully. Your order is pending super admin approval.

get.description: Returns one order of this club, populated with its `package` (including all `cycles`), the exact `cycle` that was bought, and the payment method. Another club's order -> 403.

post.description: Uploads (or replaces) the receipt on this club's order. Send `multipart/form-data` with an `image` (or `file`) field. Another club's order -> 403. Response includes the absolute `payment_proof_url`.

get.description: Returns structured invoice data for this club's order. Pass `?format=html` to get printable HTML.

200.description: Clean HTML invoice ready for print or saving as PDF

get.description: Returns the club's single cart as an array (`items`). Each line is enriched with its central `package` (including all `cycles`) and the exact `cycle` recorded on that line. `count` and `total` are computed for the whole cart.

post.summary: Add a Package to the Cart
post.description: Appends the selected package/cycle as a new cart line and returns the whole cart. Different packages are added as separate lines; adding a package that is already in the cart -> 409. Prices always come from the central package/cycle.

put.description: Replaces the whole cart with the sent array (useful to sync the client cart in one request). An empty array clears the cart. Sending the same package twice -> 400. Prices are always resolved from the central package/cycle, never from the client.

requestBody.description: The full cart. Each item needs `package_id`; `cycle_id` is required when the package has more than one cycle.

patch.description: Updates the line of the given `package_id` (no cart-line id needed): change its cycle and/or notes. 404 when the package is not in the cart.

requestBody.description: `package_id` identifies the line; send at least one of `cycle_id` / `notes`.

delete.summary: Remove a Cart Line / Clear the Cart
delete.description: With `?package_id=...` removes that line (404 if it is not in the cart). Without it, clears the whole cart.

parameters.name: package_id
parameters.description: Remove only the line of this package. Omit to clear the whole cart.

post.description: Checks out the whole cart (no cart id needed): creates one central `pending` order per line, clears the cart, and returns every created order populated with its `package` (including all `cycles`) plus the exact `cycle` that was bought. The late-renewal fine (if any) is charged once. The subscription is extended only after the super admin approves the orders. `payment_method_id` and a payment proof (file or URL) are required.

example.message: Order created and sent to the super admin for review

post.summary: Update Club Branding (Colors/Logo URL or file)
post.description: Accepts JSON (`logo` URL + colors) or multipart/form-data (logo file in `image`/`file` + colors) in the same request.

requestBody.description: Send as JSON (URL) or multipart/form-data (file upload).

logo.description: Logo URL. Alternatively upload a file in the `image`/`file` field.
